content: Un'kɔɔn we anà munii a indiir aŋàbwaŋ abyà iyàyà, wɛɛ kà isii a indiir a ndandaa anki. Kyakin wa ukwe anki akà ikikye musyen u nköölà baar bàfàsin apà Nzam: wa kàlàkwo aben anà ibɔɔn ifà imwɛy bàfàpà ipepey mbul anà mbul?
Kya yàlàkal naa baar bàfàsà ngyamàkà ayi bàpɔŋà ipepey u mbalà mwɛy, ba bàlàfàkal anki anà an'kyän a man'be.
Wɛɛ, imɛnà naa u mbwo a ibɔɔn abi, bàfàfuur man'be kà an'kyän mbul wanswà.
Ntɔn, itàkal kà aben, an'kil a in'dim a ngɔɔmà anà mà in'dim a ntab ifàlwom anki man'be.
Kyakin, umpal kalàbilà nde u mɛɛn, Klistɔ kàtɛn a Nzam naa:

content.text: « Ngye kàkwen anki ibɔɔn anà an'kab,
Apan, mɛ kàtɛn naa: "Mɛ an'yà mɛ ŋakwo akà ngye,
asànaa bàsön ya ntɔn mɛ unsà un'kaan ibaan a ntsür." »

content: Nde waa utàtɛn naa:
Kyekà, ibɔɔn abi bàfàpà asànaa ulɔɔmà Un'kɔɔn.
Kyakin nde waa kàtɛn naa:

content.text: « Le, mɛ an'yà mɛ ŋakwo ntɔn mukyer ukwen angye. »

content: Nde kàlwom ndaa yàtàtwɛb ntɔn musà yàyweel.
Yà unsà ukwen abà waa bi kàpɔŋà u mbwo a an'kab a ndür a Yɛsu Klistɔ, mbalà mwɛy ipepey.
Wɛy ngaŋ wanswà umbarà ilä byanswà ntɔn mukölà isal ande, mbalà mbɔɔn nde upɛ ibɔɔn nsil abin, abyà mpa byan'kwo akà ikikye mulwom man'be.
Wɛɛ akà Klistɔ, ungö mupà ibɔɔn mwɛy mpɛl ntɔn man'be, nde kàkyàbwaay ipepey u kɔɔ ibaal a Nzam.
Apanà nde wàmudilà kwo naa Nzam usi ayiiŋ ande ungyɛl a in'kɔl ande.
Abun, u mbwo a an'kab mwɛy amà mpɛl, nde kàbuul bàŋàkwo ipepey baar ufàpöŋ nde unsà man'be.
Apan, Dweelà In'kyɛɛl wàmukitɛɛlà imbäl sye. Ntɔn nde kàtàtɛn naa:

content.text: « Mwol kàtɛn naa: "Le nkwà in'sàdyà mɛ anà ba
Mɛ in'sàsɔn nswɛɛŋ amɛ u mpem aba,
mɛ in'sàbääb ya unsà an'kyän aba.
Mɛ in'fàsàyɔbà anki man'be aba anà ibii aba. »

content: Kyekà, ikal bàfàdwääl nkul a man'be, ndöŋ an'kab màfàkal anki ntɔn man'be.
Làkwikilà anà nkääŋ a mpem
Kyakin atɔŋ, bi ibye anà nsaay mubilà kà ikal a in'kyɛɛl aŋàsöönà u mbwo a an'kil a ibɔɔn a Yɛsu.
Apanà bi ibye anà mbwo akün anà yà mɔ̈ɔ̈ kiduub nde u rido, iswaŋà naa u mbwo a ndür ande.
Bi ibye anà undweer a angaŋ a kölàköl bàsi kà un'tswe a ndwà a Nzam.
Abun, wɛy bi isin apà Nzam anà mpem a balàbal, wàŋàyɔl a làkwikilà, mpem aŋàpɔŋà unsà ibii kyanswà kyà an'kyän anà ndür aŋàsɔŋ a an'dà aŋàpɔŋà.
Wɛy bi ikäl bàŋàtsim unsà làkyän ifàkyään bi, ntɔn Nzam wà lää unsà ilää ande.
Wɛy bi ikyɛɛŋ bi a bi, ntɔn bi ipɛɛl ngyal akwen anà yàkyer isal aŋàbwaŋ.
Bi twon ban'tiin nköŋ abi, asànaa bàyii baar bumwɛy. Wɛɛ, wɛy bi ipɛɛl ngwal, ntɔn bɛ làkimanà naa Ilä a Mwol kyàmusin.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa bi ibàmukyer man'be a kɔrà ungö muyöb ndandaa, ibɔɔn kyan'kwo mulwom man'be ifàkal anki.
Wɛɛ yan'saal nà mudil u bɔɔmà nsaŋ anà un'fur a mbaa isàkwiiy baar a un'tswe ngwal.
Mbuur usàbɛy Un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ bàkyer un'dwa ukɔɔn ngyɛb, isàkal naa baar abɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär ban'tà imbäl ntɔn ube ande.
Bɛ làsii naa ntaaŋàmbar akölàköl nà mpa kan'kwo muwal mbuur afàdyà Mwan a Nzam un'siinà, afàbɛy an'kil a nkwà u mbwo a ma kàpɔŋà nde anà afàto Dweelà a kab a ngway?
Ntɔn bi ikyun'yöb mbuur awà kàtɛn naa:

content.text: « Mɛ in'sàfuur ube udu ube, mɛ in'sàfur mbuur mbuur ntɔn isal ande! »
« Mwol asàtɛn nsaŋ a un'sɛŋ ande. »

content: Yà ndaa a bɔɔmà mbɔɔn mubwà kà an'kɔɔ a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Wɛɛ làyɔbà ilä abe byàtàtwɛb mpal làwɛl bɛ pɛɛlà a Nzam: bɛ làkyey muman mpay anwaan ngwiy a ngwal.
Mpal mwɛy bàlatö anà bàlamɛɛy nkwaaŋ u mii a baar, mpal yumwɛy bɛ làmɛnà mpay mbwo mwɛy anà baar bàkäl u mpay a tub ayi.
Inye, bɛ làwɛl kab unsà mpay a baar a bɔlokà anà bɛ làkyer akyey unsà un'sak naa bàgyɔɔr indiir abɛ, ntɔn bɛ làkyàyöb naa bɛ làbye anà un'naaŋ aŋàsöön ubwaŋ awà afàlam.
Abun, twon lan'piy làkyän abɛ, ntɔn la làfàtwaal bweel a kölàköl.
Ntɔn, bɛ làbye anà ndöŋ a muküünà ntɔn naa, ungö mukölà ukwen a Nzam, bɛ làwɛl indiir kàpɛ nde ilää.
Ntɔn, bàsön naa:

content.text: Apan, mbuur awà balàbal kusà amɛ asàkal wàmɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a làkwikilà,
wɛɛ isàkal naa nde an'furà ngö, mɛ in'sàkal anki anà un'sak amu nde. »

content: Bi, bi kà ibà baar afurà ngö anki ntɔn mukàdiimà, wɛɛ bi ibà baar a làkwikilà ntɔn muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
